Five-lined Skinks (Plestiodon fasciatus) live across eastern North America. Jonathan Carver, visiting the Great Lakes (1766−1768), wrote “it is so remarkably agile that in an instant it is out of sight… so that it might more justly be said to vanish, than to run away.”
